# export-arguments

exportArguments(args) parses an explicit array of CLI strings using util.parseArgs semantics. Return an ordinary object {tag, format, color, files}. Known options: --tag (-t), a repeatable string option defaulting to ["general"]; --format (-f), a non-repeatable string defaulting to "json"; --color, a boolean defaulting to true and supporting --no-color. Allow positional files and -- termination. Follow the documented multiple/default/allowNegative rules: explicit tags replace the default, repeated format uses the last value, and color can be enabled or disabled in input order. Unknown options and missing string values must throw as in strict parseArgs. Do not change args.

Run: `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
